svg.title: TypeScript 7 in a Real Monorepo: 3x Faster Type Checks, Mostly Config Changes
svg.desc: Two proportional bars comparing a whole-repo type check on the classic compiler, TypeScript 5.8.2 at about 74 seconds, with the native compiler, TypeScript 7.0.2 at about 24 seconds, roughly 3x faster, and the Node heap flag dropping from 8 GB to none. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism cyan accent.

g.text: One real monorepo, measured in CI
